verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins run inside ChatGPT and Codex and handle user data from Gmail, Drive, Slack, and Messages, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence never mentions any control to keep data out of model training. The closest item, Sign in with ChatGPT, only says sign-in shares name, email, and profile picture with partners, which concerns partner data sharing, not AI training.
